'''Mera''' is an older Aiel woman. She has a husband, three daughters and two sons. One of her daughters is training as an apprentice [[Wise One]].
==Activities==
On a day when the apprentice Wise Ones have been given a day off, the apprentices, along with a couple of mothers and some first-sisters, are gathered in a tent to chat. [[Egwene]] is invited to join them. The conversation eventually turns to ways in which men can be handled. Mera tells [[Surandha]] and [[Estair]] that the only way to handle any chief, whether he be a hold chief, sept chief, clan chief or the [[Car'a'carn]] himself, is the same way to handle a husband. She later tells Estair that she might be a Wise One eventually, but Estair should listen to a woman who has managed a husband and raised five children without a sister-wife to help.
